# Agent Hangar

> Self-hosted control plane for AI agents. AI clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenCode) connect to its MCP server
> at /mcp and build agents by chatting. Every agent is versioned, tested in stage and only then promoted to prod,
> runs in its own Docker container, and is exposed over OpenAI-compatible, A2A, ACP, MCP and AG-UI at /gw/<slug>.
> Documentation site: https://valteresj2.github.io/agent-hangar/docs/ (built from docs/).

Key facts for coding agents:
- The platform MCP tool flow: list_templates → list_catalog → register_agent → design_agent (JSON Merge Patch;
  null deletes) → ship_agent → create_consumer_key. The spec schema comes from get_spec_schema.
- Agent types: chat (llm.connection), harness (harness.id ∈ claude-code|codex|hermes|deepseek-harness; one ephemeral
  container per call), multi-agent (sub_agents; chat only), remote (an AG-UI agent from another framework).
- Digital employees (hire_employee) are agents with a job, a human manager and an authority level the platform
  enforces before every tool call.
- execution (optional): effort, max_output_tokens, compact/context_budget (long-context compaction) and light_model
  (a cheaper model for simple requests). Avatars: list_avatars, and `avatar` on register_agent/compose_agent.
- Connections are external LLM endpoints; protocols: openai (chat, codex, hermes), anthropic (claude-code),
  deepseek (deepseek-harness). The hangar never hosts a model.
- Auth: admin keys for /api and /mcp; invoke keys (optionally per agent) for /gw/<slug>.
